- Open a dedicated crash log page when the app crashes or takes too long to start
- Add sharing, copying, and restarting controls to the crash log page
- Protect crash details from screenshots and remove sensitive paths, addresses, and account information

---

- 在应用崩溃或启动时间过长时打开独立的崩溃日志页
- 为崩溃日志页增加分享、复制和重启操作
- 禁止截取崩溃详情，并移除其中的敏感路径、地址和账号信息
